content.short: Franklin provides hybrid cash & crypto payroll with automated tax compliance.
content.description: Since its 2022 inception, Franklin has helped Web3 founders manage their teams more smoothly. It enables payments to contributors in USD, in crypto, or in a mixed arrangement, giving organizations the flexibility to compensate team members in the way that best fits their needs. For US-based companies, Franklin handles the required tax compliance, allowing builders to concentrate on developing and delivering their projects without being tied up in administrative duties.
